question: After I submit an SCF proposal, what does the review timeline look like — prescreen, track/panel review, community vote, results, KYC — and what is the round cadence and how long does each review stage take?

golden.answer: A grounded answer consults the current official SCF Build workflow and dates a specific round's calendar. The interest form is rolling; teams first undergo eligibility/referral review and only invited teams receive a full-proposal deadline. The workflow then covers full proposal, prescreen/panel review, possible revision, an Open-only community vote, selection/notification, and information collection/KYC. Integration and RFP decisions are panel-led. Official materials describe roughly six-week Build rounds, but do not support a universal 2/1/1/1-week stage formula or guaranteed results week. After selection, KYC/KYB and award acceptance are distinct from deliverable payments; use the current award rules for payment mechanics and live round dates for a specific application.
keyFacts: Presents specific source-supported content as a current or dated observation.
Makes the as-of date visible for every changeable roster, status, version, or measurement.
Lists rolling interest, eligibility/invitation, proposal, and prescreen/panel stages.
Lists revision, Open-only vote, decision, KYC, and distinct post-award payments.
Uses roughly six-week Build rounds only as a dated cadence.
avoid: Do NOT substitute an unsupported memory claim for source-supported content.
Do NOT claim universal per-stage durations.
Do NOT call the interest form an open full proposal or apply the community vote to Integration/RFP.
Do NOT call acceptance a fourth deliverable milestone or invent a universal results week.
Do NOT present version-, provider-, interface-, or availability-sensitive observations as timeless; date the changeable part without weakening stable protocol or historical facts.
golden.notes:
CORRECTION 2026-08-04: current Build workflow supports rolling interest → eligibility/referral → invitation/full-proposal deadline → review/possible revision → Open-only vote → selection/KYC. Roughly six weeks is a dated cadence, not a universal 2/1/1/1-week stage model.
Observed 2026-11-02: communityfund.stellar.org/awards still says 'SCF Build Award rounds run every 6 weeks', but its 2026 submission deadlines (Feb 8, Mar 15, Apr 26, Jun 14, Aug 16, Nov 8-9) were 5-12 weeks apart, and SCF #46 listed Notification as TBD. Do not penalize an answer that reports these dated gaps beside the stated cadence.
